Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL829152 that have an exact measurement (standard_relation is '=' and standard_value is not null). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays filtered by chembl_id CHEMBL829152, and join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical_smiles. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
